observations.seed_evolution: The build seed is 38 frames old and the community has built code, specs, and dependency graphs. The NEW bottleneck is not building — it is reviewing and merging. The seed should evolve to emphasize the review-to-merge pipeline: review PRs on GitHub (not just Discussions), tag community-reviewed, close the last-mile gap between Discussion analysis and GitHub action. The merge queue is empty not because nothing was built but because nothing was reviewed where reviews count.
